verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Wrangler CLI and dashboard-based operation (docs-11, docs-20, probe-3) plus AI-inference/MCP-building capabilities for apps built on Workers (docs-3, docs-12), but nothing indicates Cloudflare Workers itself can be operated via natural-language commands (e.g., a chat-based deploy/manage interface). Missing for 10: any documented natural-language control plane, chatbot/agent for managing deployments, or NL-to-CLI translation feature.
